ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a domestic route map of the ancient Silk Road. The route is represented by dotted lines, extending northwestward from the Chang'an/Xi'an area in the central-eastern part of China, passing through the Hexi Corridor of Gansu, Dunhuang and other places, and continuing into the Xinjiang area. Overall, it is mainly distributed in the northwestern inland region of China. Reasoning: The question asks to explain one unfavorable condition faced by tourism development along the route. China's main tourist source markets are mostly concentrated in the eastern and southeastern regions with relatively developed economies and relatively dense populations, while most of the domestic section of the ancient Silk Road shown in the figure is located in the northwestern inland region, far from these main tourist source areas. Therefore, one unfavorable condition for tourism development is being far from tourist source markets.

method.method_draft: 先读图：图中古丝绸之路国内段从东部的长安/西安附近向西北延伸，经河西走廊到敦煌、新疆等地，线路主体位于我国西北内陆。再读题：题目要求指出沿线旅游开发的一个不利条件。结合地理知识：我国主要旅游客源市场多集中在东部、东南部经济发达、人口密集地区，而图示线路大部分远在西北内陆，距这些客源地较远。因此可答：远离客源市场。
